style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website. Landscape 3:2, modern everyday setting, original people in present-day casual clothes. NO text, letters, numerals, titles, logos, watermarks or identifiable existing characters. Communicate the specific meaning through clear actions and relationships, suitable for elementary-school readers and mobile size. Hand-drawn delicate graphite pencil contours, soft translucent watercolor washes layered with colored-pencil grain and hatching on warm ivory textured paper. Restrained natural grass greens, pale sky blues, warm earthy browns, plenty of ivory breathing room. No flat digital color blocks, no glossy shading, no 3D, no imitation of any named artist. Scene:
scene_prompt: Modern public park. Three residents react with intense moral disgust to an adult dumping a bag of rubbish into a once-clean pond. Main resident in foreground frowns deeply, nose wrinkled, lips pressed, strongly raises open palm toward dumper in refusal; a second resident turns away in disgust and shields a child from the sight. The dumper stands to the side with bag tilted downward, empty bottles and wrappers fall into the already littered shallow water. Clear cause of revulsion is cruel pollution, not dislike of a person based on appearance. No fighting or violence. Avoid merely mild surprise or sadness; show emphatic rejection and abhorrence. Natural anatomy, grounded feet, fingers and wrists correct, gravity-driven rubbish, plausible water reflections, no readable text labels brands logos or watermarks. 3:2 landscape, soft watercolor and graphite colored pencil on ivory paper.
alt: 居民看見有人把垃圾倒進池塘，皺眉露出強烈厭惡，一人舉掌制止，另一人護著孩子轉身避開。
